name: Swift Feather (waves drop)
notes: A drop of the waves mode: the classic run's Swift Feather (a pale blue feather with a grey shaft), with the same look and the same boost. A wave monster that faints has a 25% chance to drop one of the 5 items, picked at random (item 0 of drop_kind; at most 3 Swift Feathers per run, see enm_wave_1). It appears at the monster's feet, or, when the monster fainted in the dark edge the player can't walk into, on the nearest spot of lit floor (free_spot). Only the player can pick it up (monsters walk over it): walking into it plays the item chime, floats '+10% SPEED' over the player and the player walks 10% faster for the rest of the run (boost_speed, each point +10%). It adds to the same variable as the Swift Feather level-up card, so the two boosts add up. It stays on the floor until it is picked up or the run ends.
